misconceptions.doubt: The domain/staging URL means the company is unverified or temporary.
misconceptions.truth: AIPL is a permanent, certified enterprise holding an active Corporate Identification Number (CIN) dating back to 2010 with 29+ years of engineering heritage.

misconceptions.doubt: Using a gmail.com email address looks informal or unverified.
misconceptions.truth: Legacy corporations across India preserve original high-deliverability primary handles for tender & MCA security filing.

misconceptions.doubt: The legal address is in Delhi but operations are in Jharkhand, signaling a shell company.
misconceptions.truth: Splitting corporate finance/bidding hubs in Delhi from physical machinery yards in Jharkhand is standard practice for national Class 1A contractors.

misconceptions.doubt: Public databases list very few permanent employees on payroll.
misconceptions.truth: Infrastructure giants maintain core boardroom directors and project heads on payroll, while deploying hundreds of contract engineers and heavy machine operators per project budget.

misconceptions.doubt: Class 1A status is just a self-proclaimed marketing term.
misconceptions.truth: Class 1A is an official government contractor classification issued by State PWDs and Central Agencies after strict audit of financial solvency, turnover, and engineering assets.

misconceptions.doubt: They only build roads and bridges, not complex buildings.
misconceptions.truth: AIPL's portfolio spans university campuses, multi-story commercial buildings, hospitals, and turnkey residential projects.

misconceptions.doubt: They only work with government tenders and not private developers/landowners.
misconceptions.truth: AIPL actively engages in joint ventures, landowner partnerships, and private turnkey commercial/residential developments.

misconceptions.doubt: Formulating a Joint Venture (JV) on big bids means they cannot handle it alone.
misconceptions.truth: Joint Ventures are standard practice for multi-billion rupee infrastructure tenders to optimize technical bidding points and logistics.

misconceptions.doubt: They lack modern heavy earthmoving machinery.
misconceptions.truth: AIPL deploys automated batching plants, crawler pile drivers, tower cranes, pneumatic asphalt pavers, and heavy vibratory compactors across all active sites.
